active_work.scope: unique final pixel winners; reused on light-only updates; unchanged captured primitive tests

appearance.scope: opaque nonmetal direct GGX/Smith + attenuated diffuse; indirect field unchanged

kernels.scope: independent stage entry points and reachable helpers; exact original equations; real 1.2 and 1.3 comparison binaries

persistent_visibility.scope: stable source-reference/instance identity; camera independent; per-light position and metric invalidation

shared.scope: source-reference/instance identity and scene; light positions validated on GPU

source_surface.receiver_queries: once per winning source patch/light; recovered pixels reuse witnessed source

shared_visibility.scope: immutable source visibility; scene hierarchy and writable caches excluded

source_surface.source_geometry: captured tangent disks, shared master IDs
source_surface.visibility_precision: 8 bits per light; eighth light 7 bits

surface_queries.scope: resident world centers/normal intervals; 16-block parents; exact captured-disk blocking witnesses; below 32 storage descriptors use the accepted 1.2 shader

world_plan.scope: source domain + instance assembly + geometry recipe + schedule; camera/light independent

gpu_analysis.scope: Disjoint appearance passes grouped by identical options, resolution and event kind. GPU sum excludes CPU, transport and uninstrumented engine work. Largest GPU pass is not proof of a whole-system bottleneck.

comparison.scope: Same scene/options and nine-event sequence per variant; rotated mode order; one unmeasured cold rebuild per block; unchanged light stays cached within a block. No image/buffer readbacks; CPU command time is not GPU completion. Thermal state is not controlled.
